rounds.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design the PRIMARY Models decision-support panel for LAZERS, native OpenCode Desktop. References are STYLE/COMPOSITION ONLY: tasks-focus-v2.png quiet Linear-like task list; trajectory-review-v2.png meaningful chart above a horizontal inspector; models-focus-v2.png secondary assignment editor density. Do not reproduce assignment-only form. Models helps a developer choose a capable model for a coding task using task outcomes, token efficiency and cost, then assign it. Create narrow390CSS equivalent and wide680CSS equivalent panels side by side, high fidelity, readable English, compact native neutral dark theme. Closable Models tab with small hexagon icon. Small header Models, compact Project scope/refresh. Quiet Compare active / Assignments secondary navigation. One concise wrapping filter line 'UI' 'Small tasks' 'Last 30 days'. Show one compact Pareto scatter plot: y-axis 'API $ / task', x-axis 'Tokens / task', lower-left beneficial, small labeled model points Luna, Qwen, Sonnet, dashed frontier labeled 'Token–cost frontier'. Solid circles Observed; hollow diamond Projected; subtle restrained accent, no rainbow. Tiny accounting caption 'Comparable task cohort · market equivalent'. Below chart in narrow view show 3 selectable compact candidate rows, with table header 'Model' 'Accepted' 'Cost/task'; examples 'Luna · Max' '9/10' '$0.18', 'Qwen' '8/10' '$0.09', 'Sonnet' '10/10' '$0.48'. Luna selected. Wide view chart LEFT and same READ-ONLY table RIGHT above horizontal resizable divider. ALL values are illustrative design fixtures, not research claims. Put clearly visible small caption directly above plot 'Concept · illustrative data'. No badges claiming winner/best/score. Beneath divider full-width selected model inspector (never to right): 'GPT-6 Luna · Max', quiet 'OpenAI'. Small task context 'Estimate for LZ-68 · Models editor'. Prominent but native-sized '$0.14–$0.24' with text 'Projected API equivalent'; subline 'From 10 related tasks · includes retries'. Small 'View contributing trajectories' link. Disclosure 'Evidence & assumptions' collapsed; includes pricing source/freshness, comparable cohort, failures, coverage and external benchmark when available, do not expand. Secondary compact 'Assign to UI…' button. No full route fields initially; those belong Assignments subview. Quiet footer 'Illustrative historical data · not a price quote'. Focus is readable model comparison and task estimate, not chart decoration or config. 4px rhythm, compact32–36px rows,12–16px insets, subtle hairline borders, continuous panel surface, host-like typography, faint selection. No nested cards, giant KPI tiles, large headers, marketing copy, tiny unreadable text, invented score, duplicated forms or unrelated controls. Preserve all important controls in narrow layout without clipping.
